button.name: action_print_transport_order
button.invisible: state in ('closed', 'cancel') or not (scope_pickup or scope_delivery)
button.help: PDF for the haulier: pickup, delivery, containers and goods. Printed, never sent from Odoo.

button.name: action_issue_house_document
button.invisible: transport_mode != 'sea' or consolidation_role == 'master' or house_doc_issue_date or state == 'cancel'
button.confirm: Issue the house B/L? It takes its number and today's date, and stops printing as a draft.
button.help: The draft is printed from ⋮ › Print › House bill of lading, for the shipper to check.

button.name: action_issue_house_document
button.invisible: transport_mode != 'air' or consolidation_role == 'master' or house_doc_issue_date or state == 'cancel'
button.confirm: Issue the house air waybill? It takes its number and today's date, and stops printing as a draft.
button.help: The draft is printed from ⋮ › Print › House air waybill, for the shipper to check.

button.name: action_reissue_house_document
button.help: An issued B/L or air waybill does not change: reprints give the issued copy. To correct it, issue a new one (the reason is kept).
